name: Predator Ridge, Range Restaurant
lede: At the Predator Ridge golf resort, a retractable-roof pergola turned the Range restaurant and bar’s patio into a three-season dining room. Fourteen 6000 W Bromic electric heaters, LED lighting and screens keep it open in most weather.
data: Bromic electric, 6000 W (14) – model to confirm
beats: A patio at the Range restaurant and bar, under a custom retractable-roof pergola 65 ft wide, 24 ft deep and 10 ft high, on a steel platform.
The restaurant wanted its patio to welcome guests well beyond the summer.
Bella Outdoor Living designed and installed the pergola in two weeks, with fourteen 6000 W Bromic electric heaters, LED lighting and screens integrated.
